title: Third-party Liability Insurance for PMD and E-scooter Riders Working for Food Delivery Companies
what_it_is: Third-party Liability Insurance for PMD and E-scooter Riders Working for Food Delivery Companies

sections.label: Food delivery rider insurance engagement
sections.summary: LTA engaged food delivery companies; Deliveroo and GrabFood bought third-party liability insurance for e-scooter riders, AMAP considered stronger measures, and LTA promoted safe riding.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Since then, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has been engaging with major food delivery companies and two of them, Deliveroo and GrabFood, have purchased third-party liability insurance for their e-scooter riders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Meanwhile, AMAP is considering stronger measures to ensure that food delivery riders will be covered by third-party liability insurance when riding for work.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA has also engaged the food delivery companies to educate their riders on safe riding practices and to promote rider awareness on regulations.

sections.label: Joint circular on rider safety
sections.summary: In October 2018, LTA, Ministry of Manpower and Traffic Police issued a circular calling for companies to ensure rider safety and health and provide reporting avenues.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In October 2018, LTA, the Ministry of Manpower and the Traffic Police jointly issued a circular, calling for the food delivery companies to ensure the safety and health of their delivery riders by providing sufficient instruction, training and supervision.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The circular also calls for companies to provide avenues for the reporting of unsafe riding by members of public.

sections.label: Claims against food delivery companies
sections.summary: The speaker finds claims against companies difficult, understands reporting avenues exist, believes claims may be filed there, and offers discussion if unavailable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: At this point in time, we find it difficult to make claims against these companies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I understand that the companies already have avenues for reporting unsafe riding behaviour of their riders that members of public can use.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: At the same time, I believe there is an avenue for members of the public to file claims through the same avenue.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: If that is not available, we will be willing to discuss with the food delivery companies to allow that to happen.
